_readme: S2-F1, 2026-07-29 - the single definition of the pattaya-gym.com ship chain.
Before this file there were three: AGENTS.md, .internal-docs/ENRICH-2026-07.md
and SHIP-GYM.ps1. They listed different steps in different orders. AGENTS.md
omitted normalize-entity-graph.js entirely, ran verify-deploy before the
encoding and network gates, and never mentioned validate.js, verify.js,
seo-audit.js or html:validate-all. ENRICH has since been deleted. A chain
with three definitions has none, and the one that runs is whichever file the
SHIP-GYM.ps1 is the shipping authority, so it reads this file and runs exactly
what is listed here. scripts/write-ship-chain-doc.js regenerates the block in
AGENTS.md from it, and scripts/verify-ship-chain.js fails the build if the two
drift apart or if a listed script is missing. Edit this file, never the copy
SCOPE: pattaya-gym.com only. Not a template, not for another repo.

build.why: Replaces the two honest placeholders with a safe-coordinate map explorer and a source-checked coaching venue matcher; no centroid or invented coach profiles.

build.label: apply-design-2026   <-- design sweep
build.why: build-v2.js only regenerates the pages it owns. Without the two sweeps the ~59 static pages revert to the old dark chrome.

build.label: polish-design-2026  <-- design sweep
build.why: Fixes the inline-style leftovers a stylesheet cannot reach, and patches the templates that emit them.
Marks visible Thai runs lang="th" across every shipped page. A sweep, not a source fix, because the Thai-terms guide is written by scripts/write-round62-tier-b.js, which is not in this chain (S2-H3).

build.label: inject-guide-schema (re-run for FAQPage)
build.why: The write-*-guides scripts rewrite guides from scratch and drop the FAQPage schema injected earlier. verify-deploy fails without this.

build.label: build-press-kit (live figures)
build.why: Last among HTML writers except the entity/date passes: it swaps <main> on /press/ and must see the chrome the sweeps just applied.
Server-renders the first 24 search cards so no-JS users get results and client startup no longer inserts a layout-shifting viewport of content.
Replaces stale global directory counts after every HTML writer has finished; subset and address numbers are not touched.
Final reader-facing sweep: consent-first analytics, source-checked language and one publisher link, regardless of which legacy writer emitted the page.
Resolves bare founder Person nodes to @id, and gives any page showing the byline the author markup to match (S2-B1).

build.label: update-sitemap-lastmod (content-date ledger)
build.why: Must run last: it hashes the final HTML to decide each page's real change date, then writes both sitemap lastmod and JSON-LD dateModified from that one ledger (S1-4).

gates.label: verify-encoding.js (mojibake)
gates.why: On 2026-07-27 a bad save turned every baht sign and em dash in data.js, build-v2.js and build-discovery.js into codepage garbage and a build propagated it to 306 files. Every other gate stayed green, because mojibake is valid UTF-8.

Zero sister-site references in any machine-readable position, and exactly one followed timpaemi.com credit per page. Also a prebuild hook, but SHIP bypasses npm run build, so it is listed here explicitly.

gates.label: verify-regressions.js (audit 2026-07 repairs)
gates.why: Proves each defect repaired after the July 2026 audit stays repaired: the JSON-LD sister-domain leak, venue status reconciliation, dateModified integrity, and false first-hand claims.

gates.label: verify-flagship-2027.js (truth, privacy, tools)
gates.why: Hard-gates visible evidence ledgers, authorship, safe geo, publisher-link uniqueness, consent-first analytics, functional tools, SSR search and blocked operational files.

gates.label: verify-ship-chain.js (this manifest vs AGENTS.md)
gates.why: Fails if the documented chain drifts from this manifest, or if a listed script is missing. The defect S2-F1 described was three documents disagreeing; this is what stops it recurring.

gates.label: verify-asset-version.js (cache safety)
gates.why: Versioned CSS/JS is cached for a year in _headers. This fails the ship if one of those files changed without ASSET_VERSION being bumped, or if any page still references an old version - the only way a year-long cache can hurt you.

gates.label: verify-deploy.js (HARD GATE)
gates.why: No truncated HTML, NUL bytes, CSP hash drift or sitemap gaps.
Proves the 2026 chrome and the live venue count landed on every page - catches the design sweeps falling out of the chain, which no other gate sees.

gates.label: verify-redirects.js (301 vs built pages)
gates.why: The only check comparing _redirects, sitemap.xml and the pages on disk against each other. Stops a retired area x category combo being rebuilt and 301d away the day a venue refills it.

manual.why: Takes venue ids as arguments and is run deliberately, not on every ship. The July 2026 audit listed its absence from SHIP as part of the chain divergence; it is recorded here as an explicit manual step rather than left as an unexplained gap.
Run after each enrichment batch with the touched venue ids. It binds each new fact to a live source URL and proves both survived onto the generated page.
